paragraphs.source_en: No sooner had the main camp been put in order than Ieyasu sent the messenger Oguri Tadamasa racing toward Ii Naomasa's position. Tadayoshi was lord of the hundred-thousand-koku domain of Oshi Castle in Musashi, and today marked his first battle. His father-in-law Naomasa therefore remained at his side to watch over him.

paragraphs.source_en: “Report! The Hosokawa, Katō, and Inaba contingents have begun their attack and are advancing on us from behind Ii and Matsudaira.”

The Hosokawa, Katō, and Inaba contingents have begun their attack and are advancing on us from behind Ii and Matsudaira.”
units.source_zh: 细川、加藤、稻叶三队人马开始进攻，从井伊、松平背后向我们逼近。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “报！细川、加藤、稻叶三队人马开始进攻，从井伊、松平背后向我们逼近。”

paragraphs.source_en: “And Tanaka Hyōbu?”

units.source_en: “And Tanaka Hyōbu?”
units.source_zh: “田中兵部呢？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “田中兵部呢？”

paragraphs.source_en: “He passed us by and headed straight for Ishida's forces.”

units.source_en: “He passed us by and headed straight for Ishida's forces.”
units.source_zh: “越过了我们，径向石田所部而去。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “越过了我们，径向石田所部而去。”

paragraphs.source_en: It was not yet time to move. Yoshihiro was also deeply concerned about how Konishi Yukinaga, who had once insisted on holding Ōgaki Castle, would act today. Mitsunari had rejected Konishi's proposal outright. Therefore, once the disgruntled Konishi saw clearly that the Western Army had no chance of victory, he would surely abandon his position. Having witnessed the war in Korea with his own eyes, Yoshihiro understood this with perfect clarity.

units.source_en: It was not yet time to move.
units.source_zh: 现在还不该动。

units.source_en: Yoshihiro was also deeply concerned about how Konishi Yukinaga, who had once insisted on holding Ōgaki Castle, would act today.
units.source_zh: 一度坚持据守大垣城的小西行长今日会如何行动，也让义弘甚为关注。

units.source_en: Mitsunari had rejected Konishi's proposal outright.
units.source_zh: 小西的建议被三成一口拒绝。

units.source_en: Therefore, once the disgruntled Konishi saw clearly that the Western Army had no chance of victory, he would surely abandon his position.
units.source_zh: 因此，一旦看清西军毫无胜算，心怀不满的小西定会弃阵而去。

units.source_en: Having witnessed the war in Korea with his own eyes, Yoshihiro understood this with perfect clarity.
units.source_zh: 对于这一点，亲眼目睹了朝鲜战事的义弘，早已洞若观火。

paragraphs.source_zh: 现在还不该动。一度坚持据守大垣城的小西行长今日会如何行动，也让义弘甚为关注。小西的建议被三成一口拒绝。因此，一旦看清西军毫无胜算，心怀不满的小西定会弃阵而去。对于这一点，亲眼目睹了朝鲜战事的义弘，早已洞若观火。

paragraphs.source_en: Half an hour after the battle began, Shimazu Yoshihiro still remained immovable. Fukushima Masanori, whose temperament was the very opposite of Yoshihiro's, had meanwhile nearly entered hand-to-hand combat with the Ukita forces. Masanori was determined to win the foremost honor at any cost, for the future and fate of the Toyotomi house directly depended upon it. If he fell behind the Tokugawa hereditary lords, he would be disgraced and his authority greatly diminished.

units.source_en: Half an hour after the battle began, Shimazu Yoshihiro still remained immovable.
units.source_zh: 开战已半个时辰，岛津义弘还是岿然不动。

units.source_en: Fukushima Masanori, whose temperament was the very opposite of Yoshihiro's, had meanwhile nearly entered hand-to-hand combat with the Ukita forces.
units.source_zh: 而与义弘性情截然相反的福岛正则，几已与宇喜多开始肉搏战。

units.source_en: Masanori was determined to win the foremost honor at any cost, for the future and fate of the Toyotomi house directly depended upon it.
units.source_zh: 福岛正则已然铁了心，无论如何也要争个头功，这直接关系到丰臣氏的未来和命运。

units.source_en: If he fell behind the Tokugawa hereditary lords, he would be disgraced and his authority greatly diminished.
units.source_zh: 若落在了德川氏谱代大名之后，他必将颜面扫地，威严大减。

paragraphs.source_zh: 开战已半个时辰，岛津义弘还是岿然不动。而与义弘性情截然相反的福岛正则，几已与宇喜多开始肉搏战。福岛正则已然铁了心，无论如何也要争个头功，这直接关系到丰臣氏的未来和命运。若落在了德川氏谱代大名之后，他必将颜面扫地，威严大减。

paragraphs.source_en: At the same time, Masanori had Sobue Hōsai move among the enemy camps to gather intelligence. It was said that Hōsai even crushed in his hands the droppings left by messengers traveling between the camps, judging from their warmth when they had passed, so as to make his intelligence more precise.

units.source_en: At the same time, Masanori had Sobue Hōsai move among the enemy camps to gather intelligence.
units.source_zh: 同时，正则还让祖父江法斋在敌人阵间来去，收集消息。

units.source_en: It was said that Hōsai even crushed in his hands the droppings left by messengers traveling between the camps, judging from their warmth when they had passed, so as to make his intelligence more precise.
units.source_zh: 人传，江法斋甚至连往返于阵营之间的使者的粪便都一一用手捏碎，根据冷热确定他们往返的时刻，以使消息更加准确。

paragraphs.source_zh: 同时，正则还让祖父江法斋在敌人阵间来去，收集消息。人传，江法斋甚至连往返于阵营之间的使者的粪便都一一用手捏碎，根据冷热确定他们往返的时刻，以使消息更加准确。

paragraphs.source_en: Fukushima Masanori had opened the fighting and was seeking his chance, only to have Ii Naomasa and Matsudaira Tadayoshi steal the initiative. Of course, he understood perfectly well what Naomasa and Tadayoshi's charge signified.

units.source_en: Fukushima Masanori had opened the fighting and was seeking his chance, only to have Ii Naomasa and Matsudaira Tadayoshi steal the initiative.
units.source_zh: 福岛正则首先开打，正在寻求战机时，却不料被井伊直政和松平忠吉抢了先。

units.source_en: Of course, he understood perfectly well what Naomasa and Tadayoshi's charge signified.
units.source_zh: 当然，直政和忠吉冲出去意味着什么，他不是不知。

paragraphs.source_zh: 福岛正则首先开打，正在寻求战机时，却不料被井伊直政和松平忠吉抢了先。当然，直政和忠吉冲出去意味着什么，他不是不知。

paragraphs.source_en: He ordered Dan Kurōbyōe, who had not even had time to don his armor, to bring his horse, then galloped straight to the formation of Fukushima Tanba, the senior retainer commanding the vanguard.

units.source_en: He ordered Dan Kurōbyōe, who had not even had time to don his armor, to bring his horse, then galloped straight to the formation of Fukushima Tanba, the senior retainer commanding the vanguard.
units.source_zh: 他让连甲胄都来不及穿的团九郎兵卫牵过马来，径直向担任前卫的家老福岛丹波阵中奔去。

paragraphs.source_zh: 他让连甲胄都来不及穿的团九郎兵卫牵过马来，径直向担任前卫的家老福岛丹波阵中奔去。

paragraphs.source_en: By the time Ii Naomasa and Matsudaira Tadayoshi—whose charge had so fiercely provoked Fukushima Masanori—appeared before the Shimazu lines shouting their battle cries, Fukushima was already hurling himself desperately upon Ukita Hideie's vanguard on Mount Tenma. Fukushima Masanori led from the front, followed close behind by Fukushima Tanba, Fukushima Masayuki, Governor of Hōki, and Nagao Hayato; Ōno Harunaga, Lord of Shuri and favorite retainer of Lady Yodo, who had been entrusted to Masanori and accompanied the army, followed as well.

units.source_en: By the time Ii Naomasa and Matsudaira Tadayoshi—whose charge had so fiercely provoked Fukushima Masanori—appeared before the Shimazu lines shouting their battle cries, Fukushima was already hurling himself desperately upon Ukita Hideie's vanguard on Mount Tenma.
units.source_zh: 大大刺激了福岛正则的井伊直政和松平忠吉，出现在岛津阵前，高声呐喊时，福岛已亡命地扑向了天满山宇喜多秀家前锋。

units.source_en: Fukushima Masanori led from the front, followed close behind by Fukushima Tanba, Fukushima Masayuki, Governor of Hōki, and Nagao Hayato; Ōno Harunaga, Lord of Shuri and favorite retainer of Lady Yodo, who had been entrusted to Masanori and accompanied the army, followed as well.
units.source_zh: 福岛正则一马当先，其后紧跟着福岛丹波、福岛伯耆守正之、长尾隼人，另外，被托付给正则、随军而来的淀夫人宠臣大野修理亮治长也跟了来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 大大刺激了福岛正则的井伊直政和松平忠吉，出现在岛津阵前，高声呐喊时，福岛已亡命地扑向了天满山宇喜多秀家前锋。福岛正则一马当先，其后紧跟着福岛丹波、福岛伯耆守正之、长尾隼人，另外，被托付给正则、随军而来的淀夫人宠臣大野修理亮治长也跟了来。

paragraphs.source_en: Dan Kurōbyōe, running at the very front and leading Masanori's horse, was making his first appearance in battle; one can readily imagine his fervor. Ōno Harunaga brandished his long spear and clashed with Ukita retainer Kawachi Shichiemon, unhorsing him with a single thrust after only a few exchanges.

units.source_en: Dan Kurōbyōe, running at the very front and leading Masanori's horse, was making his first appearance in battle; one can readily imagine his fervor.
units.source_zh: 冲在最前面为正则牵马的团九郎兵卫，乃是第一次露脸，其激切不难想象。

units.source_en: Ōno Harunaga brandished his long spear and clashed with Ukita retainer Kawachi Shichiemon, unhorsing him with a single thrust after only a few exchanges.
units.source_zh: 大野治长挥舞着长枪，与宇喜多家的河内七右卫门厮杀到一处，几个回合便一枪将其挑落马下。

paragraphs.source_zh: 冲在最前面为正则牵马的团九郎兵卫，乃是第一次露脸，其激切不难想象。大野治长挥舞着长枪，与宇喜多家的河内七右卫门厮杀到一处，几个回合便一枪将其挑落马下。

paragraphs.source_en: Ferocious as Fukushima's assault was, Ukita's troops were no cowards who would crumble at the first touch. Ukita commanded more than twenty thousand men, and banners and standards fluttered across all of Mount Tenma.

units.source_en: Ferocious as Fukushima's assault was, Ukita's troops were no cowards who would crumble at the first touch.
units.source_zh: 福岛部进攻虽然异常凶猛，但宇喜多的部队也非一触即溃的孬种。

units.source_en: Ukita commanded more than twenty thousand men, and banners and standards fluttered across all of Mount Tenma.
units.source_zh: 宇喜多部有两万余人，整个天满山旗幡招展。

paragraphs.source_zh: 福岛部进攻虽然异常凶猛，但宇喜多的部队也非一触即溃的孬种。宇喜多部有两万余人，整个天满山旗幡招展。

paragraphs.source_en: Caught off guard by Fukushima's sudden assault, Ukita's men were timid at first, so the twenty-nine-year-old Hideie went to the front in person to direct the battle and raise their spirits.

units.source_en: Caught off guard by Fukushima's sudden assault, Ukita's men were timid at first, so the twenty-nine-year-old Hideie went to the front in person to direct the battle and raise their spirits.
units.source_zh: 面对福岛部突如其来的袭击，宇喜多的人马刚开始还有些胆怯，二十九岁的秀家遂亲临前线指挥作战，以鼓舞士气。

paragraphs.source_zh: 面对福岛部突如其来的袭击，宇喜多的人马刚开始还有些胆怯，二十九岁的秀家遂亲临前线指挥作战，以鼓舞士气。

paragraphs.source_en: Morale on the battlefield is often difficult to fathom; even so, without meticulous thought no commander can employ his troops with confidence. Ieyasu's scheme of using Ii Naomasa to provoke his allies into action had succeeded brilliantly.

units.source_en: Morale on the battlefield is often difficult to fathom; even so, without meticulous thought no commander can employ his troops with confidence.
units.source_zh: 战阵上的士气往往难以揣测，尽管如此，不周密考虑，断无法胸有成竹用兵。

units.source_en: Ieyasu's scheme of using Ii Naomasa to provoke his allies into action had succeeded brilliantly.
units.source_zh: 家康利用井伊直政使激将计，大获成功。

paragraphs.source_zh: 战阵上的士气往往难以揣测，尽管如此，不周密考虑，断无法胸有成竹用兵。家康利用井伊直政使激将计，大获成功。

paragraphs.source_en: And what did the observers on Mount Matsuo make of Fukushima Masanori rampaging across the battlefield?

units.source_en: And what did the observers on Mount Matsuo make of Fukushima Masanori rampaging across the battlefield?
units.source_zh: 对在战场上横冲直撞的福岛正则，松尾山上的旁观者又怎样看呢？

paragraphs.source_zh: 对在战场上横冲直撞的福岛正则，松尾山上的旁观者又怎样看呢？

paragraphs.source_en: After suffering Fukushima's lightning assault, Ukita Hideie rallied his commanders Honda Masashige, Akashi Teruzumi, Osafune Jihee, Ukita Tarōzaemon, Nobuhara Tosa, and the others, urging them to counterattack with all their might. Before long, Ukita's great-drum round standard and Fukushima's mountain-road banner were intermingled; the armies fell into a melee, with Ukita holding a slight advantage.

units.source_en: After suffering Fukushima's lightning assault, Ukita Hideie rallied his commanders Honda Masashige, Akashi Teruzumi, Osafune Jihee, Ukita Tarōzaemon, Nobuhara Tosa, and the others, urging them to counterattack with all their might.
units.source_zh: 遭到福岛闪电般的攻击之后，宇喜多秀家也激励部将本多正重、明石全登、长船治兵卫、宇喜多太郎左卫门、延原土佐等人，务猛烈回击。

units.source_en: Before long, Ukita's great-drum round standard and Fukushima's mountain-road banner were intermingled; the armies fell into a melee, with Ukita holding a slight advantage.
units.source_zh: 未久，宇喜多的大鼓丸旗与福岛的山道旗就混到了一起，双方陷入混战，宇喜多稍稍占据优势。

paragraphs.source_zh: 遭到福岛闪电般的攻击之后，宇喜多秀家也激励部将本多正重、明石全登、长船治兵卫、宇喜多太郎左卫门、延原土佐等人，务猛烈回击。未久，宇喜多的大鼓丸旗与福岛的山道旗就混到了一起，双方陷入混战，宇喜多稍稍占据优势。

paragraphs.source_en: Though Fukushima's men fought desperately, the enemy still drove them from the foot of Mount Tenma toward the Teratanigawa. Seeing Fukushima in peril, Katō Yoshiaki and Tsutsui Sadatsugu of the Eastern Army immediately moved into action.

units.source_en: Though Fukushima's men fought desperately, the enemy still drove them from the foot of Mount Tenma toward the Teratanigawa.
units.source_zh: 福岛的人马尽管拼命厮杀，还是被对方从天满山麓压向寺谷川。

units.source_en: Seeing Fukushima in peril, Katō Yoshiaki and Tsutsui Sadatsugu of the Eastern Army immediately moved into action.
units.source_zh: 眼见福岛不利，东军加藤嘉明和筒井定次立时动了起来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 福岛的人马尽管拼命厮杀，还是被对方从天满山麓压向寺谷川。眼见福岛不利，东军加藤嘉明和筒井定次立时动了起来。

paragraphs.source_en: Had Fukushima attacked Konishi's contingent beside Ukita's position, his defeat might have been even more pronounced.

units.source_en: Had Fukushima attacked Konishi's contingent beside Ukita's position, his defeat might have been even more pronounced.
units.source_zh: 福岛进攻的若是宇喜多阵旁的小西部，恐怕败象更甚。

paragraphs.source_zh: 福岛进攻的若是宇喜多阵旁的小西部，恐怕败象更甚。

paragraphs.source_en: Seeing his men driven back step by step, Fukushima Masanori sprang to the front and roared furiously, “You call yourselves the vanguard, yet you keep retreating! Utterly useless! Fight your way back! Any man who retreats again will be cut down on the spot!”

units.source_en: Seeing his men driven back step by step, Fukushima Masanori sprang to the front and roared furiously, “You call yourselves the vanguard, yet you keep retreating! Utterly useless!
units.source_zh: 看到己方节节败退，福岛正则跳到阵前，厉声怒吼：“身为先锋，竟节节败退，无用至极！

units.source_en: Fight your way back!
units.source_zh: 给我杀回去！

units.source_en: Any man who retreats again will be cut down on the spot!”
units.source_zh: 再有后退者，就地处决！”

paragraphs.source_zh: 看到己方节节败退，福岛正则跳到阵前，厉声怒吼：“身为先锋，竟节节败退，无用至极！给我杀回去！再有后退者，就地处决！”

paragraphs.source_en: After a brief check, Fukushima's troops fought their way forward once more.

units.source_en: After a brief check, Fukushima's troops fought their way forward once more.
units.source_zh: 经过短暂的停滞，福岛部又奋力杀了回去。

paragraphs.source_zh: 经过短暂的停滞，福岛部又奋力杀了回去。

paragraphs.source_en: Nearly an hour had passed since the battle began. The sky remained overcast, but the mist had completely dispersed.

units.source_en: Nearly an hour had passed since the battle began. The sky remained overcast, but the mist had completely dispersed.
units.source_zh: 开战已近一个时辰，虽还是阴天，但雾气均已散尽。

paragraphs.source_zh: 开战已近一个时辰，虽还是阴天，但雾气均已散尽。

paragraphs.source_en: While Fukushima and Ukita, nearest the Nakasendō, remained locked in battle, what was happening to Ishida's forces positioned at Sasao in the far north?

units.source_en: While Fukushima and Ukita, nearest the Nakasendō, remained locked in battle, what was happening to Ishida's forces positioned at Sasao in the far north?

ja.t: はどうしていたのだろうか。

units.source_zh: 距离中山道最近的福岛和宇喜多持续混战时，在最北面的笹尾扎阵的石田所部又如何了？

paragraphs.source_zh: 距离中山道最近的福岛和宇喜多持续混战时，在最北面的笹尾扎阵的石田所部又如何了？

paragraphs.source_en: Sasao lay north of the highway, and the forces initially facing it were those of Kuroda Nagamasa and Takenaka Shigekado. Soon afterward, Tanaka Yoshimasa also hurried past the Shimazu lines and made for Ishida.

units.source_en: Sasao lay north of the highway, and the forces initially facing it were those of Kuroda Nagamasa and Takenaka Shigekado.
units.source_zh: 笹尾位于官道以北，最初与其对垒的，乃是黑田长政与竹中重门。

units.source_en: Soon afterward, Tanaka Yoshimasa also hurried past the Shimazu lines and made for Ishida.
units.source_zh: 随后，田中吉政亦迅速穿过岛津阵前，向石田奔去。

paragraphs.source_zh: 笹尾位于官道以北，最初与其对垒的，乃是黑田长政与竹中重门。随后，田中吉政亦迅速穿过岛津阵前，向石田奔去。
